description: Knowledge taught by an LLM (teach.js on GitHub). Low priority; never overrides hand-written modules. Delete any entry with "auto": true if it is wrong.

patterns_en: How many continents are there on Earth?
What are the major oceans of the world?
Which is the largest continent?
patterns_rw: Ni imigabane ingahe iri ku Isi?
Ni izihe nyanja nini ziri ku Isi?
Ni uwuhe mugabane munini kurusha yose?
answer_rw:
Isi igizwe n'imigabane irindwi n'inyanja eshanu nini. Imigabane ni Afrika, Aziya, Amerika y'Amajyaruguru, Amerika y'Epfo, Antagitika, Uburayi, na Ositaraliya. Inyanja nini ni Inyanja y'Amahoro, Inyanja ya Atalantika, Inyanja y'Abahinde, Inyanja y'Amajyaruguru, n'Inyanja y'Epfo.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
The Earth is divided into seven continents and five major oceans. The continents are Africa, Asia, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe, and Australia. The major oceans are the Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Arctic, and Southern Oceans.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

patterns_en: What are the major climate types on Earth?
How do ecosystems adapt to specific climates?
What causes variations in world climates?
patterns_rw: Ni ubuhe bwoko bw'ikirere buzwi cyane ku Isi?
Ese ibinyabuzima byagenewe bite ubwoko bw'ikirere?
Ni iki gitera gutandukana kw'ibirere ku Isi?
answer_rw:
Isi igizwe n'ubwoko bw'ikirere butandukanye nk'ishyamba ry'imvura, ubutayu, na savana, buri kimwe gifite ibinyabuzima byacyo bwite bijyanye n'ubushyuhe n'imvura bihaho. Ibi bidukikije bifasha mu kurengera ubuzima bw'Isi.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
The Earth features diverse climate types such as rainforests, deserts, and savannas, each supporting unique life forms adapted to specific temperature and precipitation patterns. These ecosystems sustain global life.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

intents.label_en: Major Language Families of the World
patterns_en: What is the largest language family in the world?
Which languages belong to the Niger-Congo family?
What defines a language family?
patterns_rw: Ni uwuhe muryango w'indimi munini ku isi?
Umuryango wa Niger-Congo ugaragaramo izihe ndimi?
Imiryango y'indimi isobanura iki?
answer_rw:
Imiryango y'indimi z'isi ni amatsinda y'indimi zikomoka ku rurimi rumwe rw'ibanze. Umuryango munini kurusha yose ni uwa Indo-Uburengerazuba n'Uburayi, mu gihe Niger-Congo irimo indimi nyinshi zo muri Afurika yo munsi ya Sahara harimo n'Ikinyarwanda.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
World language families are groups of languages that share a common ancestral origin. The largest family by number of native speakers is Indo-European, while the Niger-Congo family contains the majority of languages spoken in Sub-Saharan Africa, including Kinyarwanda.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

patterns_en: Why is the Earth divided into different time zones?
How many major time zones are there on Earth?
Where does the starting point for global time originate?
patterns_rw: Kuki isi igabanyijemo imibibi y'igihe itandukanye?
Imibibi y'igihe ku isi ni ingahe?
Ni heheho isoko y'igihe cy'isi itangirira?
answer_rw:
Isi igabanyijemo imibibi y'igihe 24 bitewe n'aho igeze mu kuzunguruka kwayo ku zuba. Ibi bifasha abaturage ku isi hose guhuza amasaha agendanye n'umunsi n'ijoro. Umurongo w'isoko y'igihe utangirira i Greenwich mu Bwongereza.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
The Earth is divided into 24 major time zones based on its rotation relative to the sun. This system helps people worldwide coordinate their daily schedules with day and night. The prime meridian for universal time starts in Greenwich, England.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

patterns_en: What is crop rotation in agriculture?
What are the benefits of practicing crop rotation?
How does this method help control pests?
patterns_rw: Guhinduranya imbuto bisobanura iki mu buhinzi?
Ni izihe nyungu zo guhinduranya imbuto mu murima?
Ubu buryo bufasha gute mu kurwanya udukoko?
answer_rw:
Guhinduranya imbuto ni uburyo bwo gutera ubwoko butandukanye bw'ibihingwa mu murima umwe uko ibihe bihunze. Bifasha mu kongera intungamubiri mu butaka, kurwanya udukoko n'indwara, no kongera umusaruro w'ubuhinzi.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
Crop rotation is the practice of growing different types of crops in the same area across sequential seasons. It helps improve soil fertility, manage pests and diseases, and increase overall agricultural productivity.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

patterns_en: Why is organic fertilizer good for the soil?
What materials are needed to make compost?
How does composting help farmers?
patterns_rw: Ni iki gituma ifumbire y'imborera ari nziza ku butaka?
Ni ibiki bikenewe mu gukora ifumbire y'imborera?
Ese ifumbire y'imborera ifasha mu ki abahinzi?
answer_rw:
Ifumbire y'imborera ikoreshwa mu kongera intungamubiri mu butaka. Ikorwa mu bisigazwa by'ibimera n'amatungo. Ifasha abahinzi kubona umusaruro mwiza kandi yoroshye kuyitegura.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
Composting improves soil nutrients using plant and animal waste. It helps farmers increase crop yields and is usually easy to prepare locally.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

patterns_en: What are the common irrigation methods?
Why is irrigation important?
How is water delivered to crops?
patterns_rw: Ni ubuhe buryo bwo kuhira bukoreshwa cyane?
Kuki kuhira imirima ari ingenzi?
Ni gute amazi agezwa ku bihingwa?
answer_rw:
Uburyo bwo kuhira imirima bufasha abahinzi guha ibihingwa amazi ahagije mu gihe cy'amapfa. Hari uburyo bwinshi nko kunyunyiza amazi cyangwa kuyayobora mu mirongo. Ibi bituma umusaruro wiyongera.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
Irrigation methods help farmers provide sufficient water to crops during dry periods. There are various techniques such as sprinkler and furrow irrigation. These methods help increase agricultural yields.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

patterns_en: How do you select good seeds?
Where is the best place to store seeds?
Why do seeds need proper care?
patterns_rw: Ni gute wahitamo imbuto nziza?
Ni he hantu heza ho kubika imbuto?
Kuki imbuto zikeneye kwitabwaho?
answer_rw:
Guhitamo imbuto nziza ni ngombwa mu buhinzi. Abahinzi bagomba guhitamo imbuto zifite ubuziranenge kandi zitanduye indwara. Kubika imbuto neza mu hantu humye kandi hakonje bituma zitangirika kandi zigera mu gihe cy'ihinga ziri nzima.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
Selecting good seeds is essential in agriculture. Farmers should choose high-quality and disease-free seeds. Storing seeds properly in a dry and cool place prevents damage and ensures they remain viable for the planting season.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

patterns_en: What causes soil erosion in Rwanda?
How can soil erosion be prevented?
What are the impacts of soil erosion on agriculture?
patterns_rw: Ni iki gitera isuri mu Rwanda?
Ni gute isuri yafatanywa mu kurwanywa?
Ingaruka z'isuri ku buhinzi ni izihe?
answer_rw:
Isuri ni ikibazo cyugarije ubutaka bw'u Rwanda bitewe n'imisozi miremire n'imvura nyinshi. Ibi bitwara intungamubiri z'ubutaka bigateza n'inkangu. Leta n'abaturage bashyiraho ingamba nko gukora terrase na gahunda yo gutera ibiti kugira ngo barinde ubutaka bwabo.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
Soil erosion is a major environmental challenge in Rwanda due to the country's steep topography and heavy rainfall. It removes vital soil nutrients and causes landslides. The government and citizens implement measures like radical terraces and tree planting initiatives to protect agricultural land and prevent environmental degradation.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

patterns_en: How is waste managed in Rwanda?
Are all plastics banned in Rwanda?
What can be done to protect the environment?
patterns_rw: Ni gute imyanda icungwa mu Rwanda?
Ese amaplastiki yose arabujijwe mu Rwanda?
Ni iki cyakorwa kugira ngo ibidukikije birindwe?
answer_rw:
Gucunga imyanda mu Rwanda ni gahunda y'ingenzi yo kubungabunga ibidukikije. Leta y'u Rwanda yashyizeho amategeko abuzanya amplastike akoreshwa rimwe gusa. Hari ibigo bishinzwe gutondeka no gutunganya imyanda kugira ngo hatagira ingaruka mbi ku buzima bw'abaturage.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
Waste management in Rwanda is an essential practice for environmental protection. The government of Rwanda has established laws banning single-use plastics. There are designated institutions responsible for sorting and processing waste to prevent negative impacts on public health.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

patterns_en: What contributes to Rwanda's biodiversity?
Which national parks have the most wildlife in Rwanda?
How can we protect biodiversity?
patterns_rw: Ni iki gitera urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima mu Rwanda?
Ni izihe pariki zibamo inyamaswa nyinshi mu Rwanda?
Ni gute twarinda urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima?
answer_rw:
u Rwanda rufite urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima rutandukanye cyane. Harimo amashyamba yo mu misozi miremire, pariki z'igihugu, n'ibyanya bikomewe. Ibi byose bitanga ubuzima ku bwoko bwinshi bw'inyamaswa n'ibimera. Ibikorwa by'abantu n'imihindagurikire y'ikirere biri mu bishobora gushyira ubwo buzima mu kaga.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
Rwanda has a diverse range of biological life. This includes montane forests, national parks, and protected reserves. These areas support many species of animals and plants. Human activities and climate change pose threats to this environment.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.

patterns_en: What causes air pollution?
What are the effects of air pollution?
How can we prevent air pollution?
patterns_rw: Ni iki gitera umwanda wo mu kirere?
Umwanda wo mu kirere ugira ingaruka izihe?
Ni gute twakumira umwanda wo mu kirere?
answer_rw:
Umwanda wo mu kirere ni igihe ibintu bihumanya ikirere byangiza ubuzima bw'abantu n'ibidukikije. Ibyo bintu birimo imyotsi y'imodoka n'inganda. Mu Rwanda, ubuyobozi bushyiraho ingamba zo kugabanya uwo mwanda kugira ngo abaturage bagire ubuzima bwiza.

⚠️ Ubu bumenyi bwigishijwe na AI, bushobora kwibeshya.
answer_en:
Air pollution occurs when harmful substances damage the atmosphere, negatively affecting human health and the environment. Major sources include vehicle emissions and industrial smoke. In Rwanda, authorities implement measures to reduce air pollution to ensure public well-being.

⚠️ This knowledge was taught by an AI and may contain mistakes.
